			limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_balance_floor value = TFR_SPA_balance_before_economy_research_speed_factor compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_floor = TFR_SPA_balance_before_economy_research_speed_factor }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_base_economy_research_speed_factor value = TFR_SPA_balance_floor compare = less_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_restore = TFR_SPA_balance_floor }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_restore = TFR_SPA_base_economy_research_speed_factor }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_research_speed_factor = TFR_SPA_balance_restore }
			set_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_research_speed_factor = TFR_SPA_balance_floor }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_floor = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_balance_floor value = TFR_SPA_balance_before_navy_convoy_escort_efficiency compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_floor = TFR_SPA_balance_before_navy_convoy_escort_efficiency }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_base_navy_convoy_escort_efficiency value = TFR_SPA_balance_floor compare = less_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_restore = TFR_SPA_balance_floor }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_restore = TFR_SPA_base_navy_convoy_escort_efficiency }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_navy_convoy_escort_efficiency = TFR_SPA_balance_restore }
			set_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_navy_convoy_escort_efficiency = TFR_SPA_balance_floor }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_floor = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_balance_floor value = TFR_SPA_balance_before_navy_naval_hit_chance compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_floor = TFR_SPA_balance_before_navy_naval_hit_chance }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_base_navy_naval_hit_chance value = TFR_SPA_balance_floor compare = less_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_restore = TFR_SPA_balance_floor }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_restore = TFR_SPA_base_navy_naval_hit_chance }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_navy_naval_hit_chance = TFR_SPA_balance_restore }
			set_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_navy_naval_hit_chance = TFR_SPA_balance_floor }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_floor = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_balance_floor value = TFR_SPA_balance_before_navy_navy_anti_air_attack_factor compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_floor = TFR_SPA_balance_before_navy_navy_anti_air_attack_factor }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_base_navy_navy_anti_air_attack_factor value = TFR_SPA_balance_floor compare = less_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_restore = TFR_SPA_balance_floor }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_restore = TFR_SPA_base_navy_navy_anti_air_attack_factor }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_navy_navy_anti_air_attack_factor = TFR_SPA_balance_restore }
			set_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_navy_navy_anti_air_attack_factor = TFR_SPA_balance_floor }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_floor = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_balance_floor value = TFR_SPA_balance_before_navy_repair_speed_factor compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_floor = TFR_SPA_balance_before_navy_repair_speed_factor }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_base_navy_repair_speed_factor value = TFR_SPA_balance_floor compare = less_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_restore = TFR_SPA_balance_floor }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_balance_restore = TFR_SPA_base_navy_repair_speed_factor }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_navy_repair_speed_factor = TFR_SPA_balance_restore }
			set_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_navy_repair_speed_factor = TFR_SPA_balance_floor }
		}
		set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_balance_revision_1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_rework_initialized NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_construction_revision_1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_P01 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_speed_industrial_complex_factor = 0.2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_E01 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_speed_industrial_complex_factor = 0.15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_E02 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_speed_industrial_complex_factor = 0.15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_E13 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_speed_industrial_complex_factor = -0.2 }
			add_tech_bonus = { name = TFR_SPA_civilian_development_priority bonus = 1.0 ahead_reduction = 2 uses = 1 category = industry }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_E17 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_speed_industrial_complex_factor = -0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.05 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_E32 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_speed_industrial_complex_factor = -0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.05 }
		}
		set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_construction_revision_1
	}
}

TFR_SPA_expire_recovery_programme = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme > 0 } OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_legacy_clock any_state = { has_state_flag = { flag = SPA_national_recovery_2civ days > 1824 } } } AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_legacy_clock } has_country_flag = { flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_started days > 1824 } } } }
		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme = 0 }
		set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_expired
	}
}

TFR_SPA_start_recovery_programme = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_started } NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_expired } }
		set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_started
		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme = 1 }
	}
}

TFR_SPA_advance_recovery_programme_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_expired } check_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme > 0 } check_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme < 2 } }
		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme = 2 }
	}
}

TFR_SPA_advance_recovery_programme_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_expired } check_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme > 0 } check_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme < 3 } }
		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme = 3 }
	}
}

		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_industrial_capacity_factory = -0.2 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_industrial_capacity_dockyard = -0.2 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_consumer_goods_factor = 0.2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_stage = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_ai_get_ally_desire_factor = -200 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_ai_join_ally_desire_factor = -200 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_join_faction_tension = 0.5 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_industrial_capacity_factory = -0.14 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_industrial_capacity_dockyard = -0.14 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = -0.07 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_consumer_goods_factor = 0.15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_stage = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_industrial_capacity_factory = -0.07 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_industrial_capacity_dockyard = -0.07 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = -0.04 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_consumer_goods_factor = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_stage < 4 } }
		set_rule = { can_decline_call_to_war = yes }
		set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_decline_override
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_decline_override }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_volunteer_mode } }
				clear_rule = { can_decline_call_to_war = yes }
			}
			clr_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_decline_override
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = TFR_SPA_full_war_commitment TFR_SPA_main_axis_war = yes }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_industrial_capacity_factory = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_army_army_org_factor = 0.025 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_consumer_goods_factor = 0.1 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_E32 has_completed_focus = TFR_SPA_an_iberian_economic_powerhouse } }
		add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_economy_consumer_goods_factor = -0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_rework_initialized }
		if = {
			limit = { TFR_SPA_air_branch_started = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = TFR_SPA_air_dynamic } } }
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = TFR_SPA_air_dynamic }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = TFR_SPA_air_dynamic } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = TFR_SPA_air_dynamic }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_rework_initialized }
		if = {
			limit = { TFR_SPA_navy_branch_started = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = TFR_SPA_navy_dynamic } } }
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = TFR_SPA_navy_dynamic }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = TFR_SPA_navy_dynamic } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = TFR_SPA_navy_dynamic }
			}
		}
	}
}

		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_navy_navy_anti_air_attack_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_navy_navy_fuel_consumption_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_navy_navy_fuel_consumption_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_navy_navy_max_range_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_navy_navy_max_range_factor = 0 }

		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_navy_repair_speed_factor = 0 }

		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_navy_spotting_chance = 0 }
		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_stage = 4 }
		set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = SPA_recovering_from_civil_war } set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_stage = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = SPA_recovering_from_civil_war_2 } set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_stage = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = SPA_recovering_from_civil_war_3 } set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_stage = 3 } }

		remove_ideas = SPA_recovering_from_civil_war_2
		remove_ideas = SPA_recovering_from_civil_war_3

		}

			limit = { has_idea = SPA_italian_shipbuilding_expertise }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_industrial_capacity_dockyard = 0.1 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_industrial_capacity_dockyard = 0.1 }
			remove_ideas = SPA_italian_shipbuilding_expertise
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = SPA_the_duty_to_work }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_industrial_capacity_factory = 0.1 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_industrial_capacity_factory = 0.1 }

			if = {
				limit = { any_state = { has_state_flag = SPA_national_recovery_2civ } }
				set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_legacy_clock
			}

		}
		if = {

			if = {
				limit = { any_state = { has_state_flag = SPA_national_recovery_2civ } }
				set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_legacy_clock
			}
			remove_ideas = SPA_national_recovery_2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = SPA_national_recovery_3 }

			if = {
				limit = { any_state = { has_state_flag = SPA_national_recovery_2civ } }

			}
			remove_ideas = SPA_national_recovery_3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = SPA_national_recovery_4 }
			set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme = 4 }
			set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_started
			if = {
				limit = { any_state = { has_state_flag = SPA_national_recovery_2civ } }
				set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_legacy_clock
			}
			remove_ideas = SPA_national_recovery_4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = SPA_national_recovery_5 }
			set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme = 5 }
			set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_started
			if = {
				limit = { any_state = { has_state_flag = SPA_national_recovery_2civ } }
				set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_legacy_clock
			}
			remove_ideas = SPA_national_recovery_5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = SPA_national_recovery_6 }
			set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme = 6 }
			set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_started
			if = {
				limit = { any_state = { has_state_flag = SPA_national_recovery_2civ } }
				set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_legacy_clock
			}
			remove_ideas = SPA_national_recovery_6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = SPA_national_recovery_7 }
			set_variable = { TFR_SPA_recovery_programme = 7 }
			set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_programme_started
			if = {
				limit = { any_state = { has_state_flag = SPA_national_recovery_2civ } }
				set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_recovery_legacy_clock
			}
			remove_ideas = SPA_national_recovery_7
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = SPA_expand_the_axis_gold_trade }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.15 }
			add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.15 }
			remove_ideas = SPA_expand_the_axis_gold_trade
		}
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = SPA_the_national_and_popular_army_of_spain_2mil }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_building_mil = 2 } }
		}
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = SPA_support_the_war_industry_1civ }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_building_civ = 1 } }
		}
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = SPA_expand_the_war_industry_2mil }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_building_mil = 2 } }
		}
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = SPA_national_recovery_2civ }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_building_civ = 2 } }
		}
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = SPA_ensure_agricultural_self_sufficiency_2civ }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_building_civ = 2 } }
		}
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = SPA_invest_in_naval_infrastructure_3DY }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_building_dock = 3 } }
		}
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = SPA_expand_the_slipways_3DY }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_building_dock = 3 } }
		}
		TFR_SPA_refresh_modifiers = yes
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = TFR_SPA_economy_dynamic }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = TFR_SPA_army_dynamic }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}

TFR_SPA_enforce_volunteer_rules = {
	set_rule = {
	        desc = TFR_SPA_volunteer_role_tt
	        can_not_declare_war = yes
	        can_join_factions = no
	        can_create_factions = no
	        can_decline_call_to_war = yes
	    }
	    clr_country_flag = accessible_shared_tree
	    if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = axis_dynamic } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = axis_dynamic } }
	    if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
}

TFR_SPA_flush_building_rewards = {
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_pending_41_civ > 0 } 41 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = yes } industrial_complex < 20 } }
		break = TFR_SPA_queue_break
		41 = {
			set_variable = { TFR_SPA_before = building_level@industrial_complex }

TFR_SPA_flush_naval_arsenals = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_pending_naval_arsenal_a > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { any_owned_state = { has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_naval_arsenal_a } } }
			random_owned_controlled_state = {
				limit = { is_core_of = PREV is_coastal = yes dockyard < 18 free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 2 include_locked = yes } NOT = { has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_naval_arsenal_b } }
				set_state_flag = TFR_SPA_naval_arsenal_a
			}
		}
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_pending_naval_arsenal_a > 0 } any_owned_state = { has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_naval_arsenal_a is_owned_and_controlled_by = PREV is_core_of = PREV is_coastal = yes dockyard < 20 free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 0 include_locked = yes } } }
			break = TFR_SPA_queue_break
			random_owned_controlled_state = {
				limit = { has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_naval_arsenal_a is_owned_and_controlled_by = PREV is_core_of = PREV is_coastal = yes dockyard < 20 free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 0 include_locked = yes } }
				            set_variable = { TFR_SPA_before = building_level@dockyard }
				            add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				            add_building_construction = { type = dockyard level = 1 instant_build = yes }
				            if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = building_level@dockyard value = TFR_SPA_before compare = greater_than } } PREV = { subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_pending_naval_arsenal_a = 1 } } }
				            else = { PREV = { set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_queue_break = 1 } } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_queue_break = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_pending_naval_arsenal_b > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { any_owned_state = { has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_naval_arsenal_b } } }
			random_owned_controlled_state = {
				limit = { is_core_of = PREV is_coastal = yes dockyard < 18 free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 2 include_locked = yes } NOT = { has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_naval_arsenal_a } }
				set_state_flag = TFR_SPA_naval_arsenal_b
			}
		}
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_pending_naval_arsenal_b > 0 } any_owned_state = { has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_naval_arsenal_b is_owned_and_controlled_by = PREV is_core_of = PREV is_coastal = yes dockyard < 20 free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 0 include_locked = yes } } }
			break = TFR_SPA_queue_break
			random_owned_controlled_state = {
				limit = { has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_naval_arsenal_b is_owned_and_controlled_by = PREV is_core_of = PREV is_coastal = yes dockyard < 20 free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 0 include_locked = yes } }
				            set_variable = { TFR_SPA_before = building_level@dockyard }
				            add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				            add_building_construction = { type = dockyard level = 1 instant_build = yes }
				            if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = building_level@dockyard value = TFR_SPA_before compare = greater_than } } PREV = { subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_pending_naval_arsenal_b = 1 } } }
				            else = { PREV = { set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_queue_break = 1 } } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_queue_break = 0 }
	}
}

TFR_SPA_request_axis_membership = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_faction_with = GER }
		set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_axis_membership_accepted
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { TFR_SPA_axis_membership_eligible = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_axis_request_pending } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = TFR_SPA_axis_request_pending days = 30 }
			GER = { country_event = { id = TFR_spain_rework.1 days = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

TFR_SPA_portugal_agreement = {
	save_event_target_as = TFR_SPA_recipient
	    NPR = {
	        every_owned_state = {
	            limit = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = NPR }
	            set_building_level = { type = infrastructure level = 5 }
	            save_event_target_as = TFR_SPA_portuguese_state
	            NPR = { give_resource_rights = { receiver = event_target:TFR_SPA_recipient state = event_target:TFR_SPA_portuguese_state } }
	        }
	    }
}

TFR_SPA_begin_relocation = {
	if = {
	        limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = TFR_SPA_portugal_relocation_started } }
	        set_global_flag = TFR_SPA_portugal_relocation_started
	        set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_relocating_industry
	        NPR = {
	            set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_stop_portuguese_industry_growth
	            every_owned_state = {
	                set_state_flag = TFR_SPA_industry_source
	                set_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_civ = building_level@industrial_complex }
	                set_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_mil = building_level@arms_factory }
	                set_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_dock = building_level@dockyard }
	            }
	        }
	    }
	    TFR_SPA_process_relocation = yes
}

TFR_SPA_process_relocation = {
	save_event_target_as = TFR_SPA_recipient
	NPR = {
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = NPR has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_industry_source }
			        # Never recreate factories destroyed or moved by another mechanic.
			        if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_owed_civ value = building_level@industrial_complex compare = greater_than } } set_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_civ = building_level@industrial_complex } }
			        save_event_target_as = TFR_SPA_industry_source
			        while_loop_effect = {
			            limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_civ > 0 } event_target:TFR_SPA_recipient = { any_owned_state = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = PREV is_core_of = PREV industrial_complex < 20 free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = yes } } } }
			            break = TFR_SPA_transfer_break
			            event_target:TFR_SPA_recipient = {
			                random_owned_controlled_state = {
			                    limit = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = PREV is_core_of = PREV industrial_complex < 20 free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = yes } }
			                    set_variable = { TFR_SPA_before = building_level@industrial_complex }
			                    add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			                    add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			                    if = {
			                        limit = { check_variable = { var = building_level@industrial_complex value = TFR_SPA_before compare = greater_than } }
			                        event_target:TFR_SPA_industry_source = {
			                            remove_building = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 }
			                            subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_civ = 1 }
			                        }
			                        event_target:TFR_SPA_recipient = { add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_transferred_civ = 1 } }
			                    }
			                    else = { event_target:TFR_SPA_industry_source = { set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_transfer_break = 1 } } }
			                }
			            }
			        }
			        set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_transfer_break = 0 }
		}
	}
	NPR = {
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = NPR has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_industry_source }
			        # Never recreate factories destroyed or moved by another mechanic.
			        if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_owed_mil value = building_level@arms_factory compare = greater_than } } set_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_mil = building_level@arms_factory } }
			        save_event_target_as = TFR_SPA_industry_source
			        while_loop_effect = {
			            limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_mil > 0 } event_target:TFR_SPA_recipient = { any_owned_state = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = PREV is_core_of = PREV arms_factory < 20 free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 include_locked = yes } } } }
			            break = TFR_SPA_transfer_break
			            event_target:TFR_SPA_recipient = {
			                random_owned_controlled_state = {
			                    limit = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = PREV is_core_of = PREV arms_factory < 20 free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 include_locked = yes } }
			                    set_variable = { TFR_SPA_before = building_level@arms_factory }
			                    add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			                    add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			                    if = {
			                        limit = { check_variable = { var = building_level@arms_factory value = TFR_SPA_before compare = greater_than } }
			                        event_target:TFR_SPA_industry_source = {
			                            remove_building = { type = arms_factory level = 1 }
			                            subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_mil = 1 }
			                        }
			                        event_target:TFR_SPA_recipient = { add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_transferred_mil = 1 } }
			                    }
			                    else = { event_target:TFR_SPA_industry_source = { set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_transfer_break = 1 } } }
			                }
			            }
			        }
			        set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_transfer_break = 0 }
		}
	}
	NPR = {
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = NPR has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_industry_source }
			        # Never recreate factories destroyed or moved by another mechanic.
			        if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_owed_dock value = building_level@dockyard compare = greater_than } } set_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_dock = building_level@dockyard } }
			        save_event_target_as = TFR_SPA_industry_source
			        while_loop_effect = {
			            limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_dock > 0 } event_target:TFR_SPA_recipient = { any_owned_state = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = PREV is_core_of = PREV dockyard < 20 free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 0 include_locked = yes } is_coastal = yes } } }
			            break = TFR_SPA_transfer_break
			            event_target:TFR_SPA_recipient = {
			                random_owned_controlled_state = {
			                    limit = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = PREV is_core_of = PREV dockyard < 20 free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 0 include_locked = yes } is_coastal = yes }
			                    set_variable = { TFR_SPA_before = building_level@dockyard }
			                    add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			                    add_building_construction = { type = dockyard level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			                    if = {
			                        limit = { check_variable = { var = building_level@dockyard value = TFR_SPA_before compare = greater_than } }
			                        event_target:TFR_SPA_industry_source = {
			                            remove_building = { type = dockyard level = 1 }
			                            subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_dock = 1 }
			                        }
			                        event_target:TFR_SPA_recipient = { add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_transferred_dock = 1 } }
			                    }
			                    else = { event_target:TFR_SPA_industry_source = { set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_transfer_break = 1 } } }
			                }
			            }
			        }
			        set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_transfer_break = 0 }
		}
	}
	if = {
	        limit = {
	            has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_relocating_industry
	            NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_relocation_complete }
	            NOT = { any_state = { has_state_flag = TFR_SPA_industry_source OR = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_civ > 0 } check_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_mil > 0 } check_variable = { TFR_SPA_owed_dock > 0 } } } }
	        }
	        clr_country_flag = TFR_SPA_relocating_industry
	        set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_relocation_complete
	        country_event = { id = TFR_spain_rework.4 days = 1 }
	    }
}

TFR_SPA_upgrade_supply_railways = {
	if = {
		limit = { 41 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT } 171 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_railway_level = { state = 41 level = 3 } has_railway_level = { state = 171 level = 3 } }
			add_political_power = 50
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { has_railway_level = { state = 41 level = 2 } has_railway_level = { state = 171 level = 2 } } }
				build_railway = { start_state = 41 target_state = 171 build_only_on_allied = yes level = 3 }
			}
			else = {
				build_railway = { start_state = 41 target_state = 171 build_only_on_allied = yes level = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_political_power = 50
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 41 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT } 165 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_railway_level = { state = 41 level = 3 } has_railway_level = { state = 165 level = 3 } }
			add_political_power = 50
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { has_railway_level = { state = 41 level = 2 } has_railway_level = { state = 165 level = 2 } } }
				build_railway = { start_state = 41 target_state = 165 build_only_on_allied = yes level = 3 }
			}
			else = {
				build_railway = { start_state = 41 target_state = 165 build_only_on_allied = yes level = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_political_power = 50
	}
}

TFR_SPA_expand_naval_bases = {
	if = {
		limit = { 171 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT any_province_building_level = { province = { id = 758 } building = naval_base level < 10 } } }
		171 = { if = {
			limit = { any_province_building_level = { province = { id = 758 } building = naval_base level < 10 } }
			add_building_construction = { type = naval_base province = 758 level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_province_building_level = { province = { id = 758 } building = naval_base level < 10 } }
			add_building_construction = { type = naval_base province = 758 level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		 }
	}
	else = {
		add_political_power = 25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 169 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT any_province_building_level = { province = { id = 1048 } building = naval_base level < 10 } } }
		169 = { if = {
			limit = { any_province_building_level = { province = { id = 1048 } building = naval_base level < 10 } }
			add_building_construction = { type = naval_base province = 1048 level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_province_building_level = { province = { id = 1048 } building = naval_base level < 10 } }
			add_building_construction = { type = naval_base province = 1048 level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		 }
	}
	else = {
		add_political_power = 25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 168 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT any_province_building_level = { province = { id = 10024 } building = naval_base level < 10 } } }
		168 = { if = {
			limit = { any_province_building_level = { province = { id = 10024 } building = naval_base level < 10 } }
			add_building_construction = { type = naval_base province = 10024 level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_province_building_level = { province = { id = 10024 } building = naval_base level < 10 } }
			add_building_construction = { type = naval_base province = 10024 level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		 }
	}
	else = {
		add_political_power = 25
	}
}
